name: What types of stucco finishes can be repaired?

mainEntity.name: What types of stucco finishes can be repaired?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most common stucco finishes can be repaired, including smooth, sand, dash, lace, and Santa Barbara finishes. The key to a successful repair is matching the texture and aggregate size of the existing stucco. Professional contractors carry a variety of tools and can mix materials to replicate different finishes as closely as possible. While achieving a perfect, invisible match can be challenging, skilled application significantly minimizes the appearance of the repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most stucco finishes like smooth, sand, dash, lace, and Santa Barbara can be repaired by matching texture and aggregate, though a perfect match can be challenging.
